profile.name: Danuson Cheounsanguan
profile.description: Software Developer with 5+ years of experience building web and mobile applications with React, Next.js, Node.js, and Flutter. Experienced shipping products from initial development through production

experience.overview: Software Developer working across web and mobile, with a growing focus on cross-team collaboration, technical feasibility, UI/UX discussions, and process improvements alongside hands-on coding.
keyContributions: Built a complete authentication system including OTP verification, social sign-in (OAuth), password management, and secure token refresh/rotation.
Designed a reusable shared component library with a consistent, documented structure and Storybook-based visual testing.
Maintained a GraphQL code generation, producing fully typed queries, mutations, and React hooks from schema introspection.
Deployed and managed web and mobile apps across separate development, staging, and production environments, using GitHub Actions and Railway auto-deploy with environment-specific configs.
Implemented complex, multi-step form inputs and validation logic for a CMS project using React Hook Form and Zod, persisting form state to URL query params so progress survives refreshes and reloads.
Implemented native social sharing along with deep linking and App Links/Universal Links on mobile, routing shared links directly to in-app content, with Open Graph metadata for rich link previews.
Took ownership of assigned work end-to-end, tracking progress, following up on client feedback, and implementing fixes or additional features based on supplementary requirement documents.
Handled shifting requirements and tightened deadlines, proactively identifying the best approach and balancing scope, quality, and deadline tradeoffs to deliver results.
Collaborated in a feature-based architecture, organizing domain logic, shared UI, and providers for scalable team development.
Worked closely with Design, BA, PM, QA, and backend engineers, giving feedback and suggestions and responding quickly whenever needed.

Familiar with web application development across marketplace functionality, mobile applications, and CMS, with hands-on experience integrating Firebase Cloud Messaging, Google Cloud Platform APIs, and app release management via App Store Connect and Google Play Console.

experience.overview: Designed and developed a multi-listing application integrating the eBay API to automate bulk listing workflows for a family business, reducing repetitive manual work.
keyContributions: Designed and built a multi-listing tool integrated with the eBay API.
Built the UI with React and Material UI for fast, simple bulk listing.
Owned the project end-to-end as a solo developer, from problem definition to implementation.

experience.overview: Frontend Developer building a React-based CMS for a supply chain service, focused on data visualization, validation, and performance.
keyContributions: Built visualization and validation features for a supply chain CMS using React and D3.js.
Improved application performance by optimizing client-side caching strategies.
Worked directly with clients through weekly meetings to gather requirements and report progress.
Supported urgent production deployments and critical fixes under tight deadlines.

experience.overview: Frontend Developer on a telemedicine app enabling remote video/voice consultations, in a small two-person dev team with direct client contact.
keyContributions: Built the frontend of a telemedicine platform using Next.js.
Implemented real-time video and voice communication using WebRTC.
Communicated directly with clients to clarify requirements and gather feedback.
